CVE-2023-3595.description: Rockwell Automation ControlLogix EtherNet/IP communication module allows remote code execution via malicious CIP messages. Affects firmware versions prior to 33.011.
CVE-2023-3595.patch: Update to firmware version 33.011 or later.

CVE-2022-22965.description: Spring4Shell: Remote Code Execution vulnerability in Spring Framework allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted HTTP requests. Relevant to SCADA web HMIs built with Java.
CVE-2022-22965.patch: Update Spring Framework to 5.3.18 or 5.2.20 or later.

CVE-2021-22005.description: VMware vCenter Server arbitrary file upload vulnerability allowing remote code execution. vCenter often manages ESXi hosts running SCADA VMs in smart grid environments.

CVE-2020-14882.description: Oracle WebLogic Server remote code execution vulnerability. WebLogic is sometimes used in utility enterprise backends connected to OT networks.
CVE-2020-14882.patch: Apply Oracle Critical Patch Update October 2020.

CVE-2023-38408.description: OpenSSH remote code execution via ssh-agent forwarding. Affects SSH connections to ICS engineering workstations.

CVE-2019-18935.description: Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX deserialization vulnerability enabling remote code execution. Found in utility web portals.
affected_products: Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX R1 2020 and earlier
CVE-2019-18935.patch: Update to Telerik UI R1 2020 SP1 or later.

CVE-2024-3400.description: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS command injection vulnerability in GlobalProtect gateway. Firewalls protecting ICS DMZ are directly affected.
CVE-2024-3400.patch: Apply PAN-OS hotfix per Palo Alto advisory PAN-252214.

CVE-2022-0778.description: OpenSSL infinite loop vulnerability causing denial of service. Affects TLS connections to SCADA servers and historians.
